findings.claim: Guardian diagnostic mode, signed/JSON CleanupProof and VM restart reconciliation
findings.finding: These capabilities do not exist. Guardian emits framed worker output and exit status; opaque Gleam proof is minted from observed exit0/124/125, with exact request/database/binary bindings.
findings.required: Select an implemented/testable external lifecycle owner and real whole-unit cleanup observation across VM death. Until demonstrated, retain Unknown; do not infer from PID absence, SQLite lock or unchanged generation.

findings.claim: Automatically reclaim orphaned Processing, then complete Delivered/Failed
findings.finding: Existing ledger holds invalid/missing durable result and failed/uncertain delivery. Processing may have performed non-idempotent effects before loss; a newer epoch does not prove safe replay.
findings.required: Match exact ledger transitions and durable results; safe recovery cannot duplicate prior effects or release capacity as success on uncertainty.

findings.claim: HTTP200 means Delivered; all4xx/5xx are definitive Failed
findings.finding: HTTP status alone is insufficient. Malformed/partial responses and server failures may leave remote effects unknown.
findings.required: Validate bounded Bot API ok=true result with message_id and intended chat; classify only demonstrably rejected requests Failed. Preserve Uncertain for ambiguous outcomes.

findings.claim: Coordinator lease+epoch+storage hash suffice for effect authority; IDs include epoch
findings.finding: Current canonical Sa-plan task owner/attempt/lease and scoped authority are also required. Logical effect IDs must survive executor attempt changes; storage mutation identity and logical remote effect identity must be distinguished.
findings.required: Concrete provider checks at effect time, exact frozen canonical context for reconciliation and no fresh-epoch replay of uncertain effects.

findings.claim: Admitted and sending/<id> records; validate_update; token in LocalConfiguration
findings.finding: Actual schema uses InboxPending and per-chunk OutboxSending(worker,epoch); guard entrypoint is evaluate_update; LocalConfiguration contains storage paths/hashes/database, no bot credential.
findings.required: Bind design to actual types/APIs; declare any needed extensions explicitly, separate private HTTP config and preserve existing source acceptance until changes are reviewed.

findings.claim: telegram_simulator.gleam is an actual HTTP simulator
findings.finding: Inspected module constructs synthetic handler input and static media summaries; no HTTP server is established.
findings.required: Build a real bounded private HTTP fixture and test OTP+SQLite+HTTP integration with read counts, send attempts and crash/response faults.

findings.claim: Telegram mandates3000ms callback acknowledgment and a message-query API can resolve uncertain sends
findings.finding: Reviewed official callback section says clients wait for acknowledgment but does not establish that fixed deadline or a generic uncertain-send query API.
findings.required: Describe3s as internal SLO, guard callback identity first, and do not base recovery on an unimplemented query method.

findings.claim: All18 checklist items checked before service implementation
findings.finding: End-to-end, state-machine, telemetry and mathematical execution claims are unobserved for this planned service.
findings.required: Use canonical six-domain obligation footer with unchecked/unrun items; retain source provenance and component-only claims.

findings.finding: Diagrams differ in nodes/edges/labels and strategy remains one_for_all/rest_for_one alternative.
